product.title: 3 Hour: The Acadia Signature, Cadillac Summit & Park Loop Road

description.text: Make the most of your visit to Maine's Acadia National Park during this private, half-day guided tour with hotel pickup. Tours include bottled water and private transfers in a climate-controlled vehicle. Stops include Cadillac Mountain, Sand Beach, Thunder Hole, Otter Cliffs, Park Loop Road. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on coastal overlooks, carriage roads, and photography or adventure highlights. Ideal for visitors basing in Bar Harbor who want a guided Acadia National Park experience without coordinating park logistics, trailheads, or carriage roads on their own.
